check: Access as a Superpower showcase replayed twice from a clean SQLite store as the app-UI adapter; both replays share one fingerprint
limitations: Fixture path: the replay drives OperationService on original fixtures. It proves the domain contract on this build, not a device, a system surface, an entry point other than the runner's adapter, or a UI.

The chart, VoiceOver, Voice Control, Full Keyboard Access, and the Audio Graph: the replay submits the task's operations to OperationService as the app UI and renders nothing, so it proves the task's data contract, not any way of reaching it.

The AccessSuperpower module's choices: the replay states each operation in full. AccessSuperpowerShowcaseReplayTests in Packages/LabFeatures checks that the module builds exactly these operations and judges the task as the step descriptions say.
Imported user data: the person's collection and item here are created by operations, not adopted from staging.
Physical devices and the iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

outcome.detail: 41 of 41 steps passed. Replay fingerprint sha256:6c8bcd362021c7aea6ffba0aaf0f8d324b815a4520a0123f64c0634b9e997459. Adapter app-ui; store sqlite (schema 3, temporary file); timebase swift-continuous-clock.

steps: approve-reset: The person confirms Reset Demo.
reset: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples, 3 collections of 4, in the demo namespace. Nothing is archived, so the task has no answer yet.
find-minerals-first: All 4 mineral specimens are active: a first run archives nothing.
approve-practice-quartz: The person presses Set Up Practice, which approves archiving Quartz point.
practice-quartz: Set Up Practice, 1 of 6: archive Quartz point (Mineral specimens) at revision 1.
approve-practice-agate: Set Up Practice approves archiving Banded agate slice.
practice-agate: Set Up Practice, 2 of 6: archive Banded agate slice (Mineral specimens).
approve-practice-obsidian: Set Up Practice approves archiving Obsidian flake.
practice-obsidian: Set Up Practice, 3 of 6: archive Obsidian flake (Mineral specimens).
approve-practice-cobalt: Set Up Practice approves archiving Cobalt swatch.
practice-cobalt: Set Up Practice, 4 of 6: archive Cobalt swatch (Pigment swatches).
approve-practice-ochre: Set Up Practice approves archiving Ochre swatch.
practice-ochre: Set Up Practice, 5 of 6: archive Ochre swatch (Pigment swatches).
approve-practice-vellum: Set Up Practice approves archiving Tracing vellum.
practice-vellum: Set Up Practice, 6 of 6: archive Tracing vellum (Paper stock).
find-pigments-active: The first bar: Pigment swatches has 2 of 4 archived, so only Amber swatch and Verdigris swatch are active.
find-minerals-active: The middle bar: Mineral specimens has 3 of 4 archived, the most. Only Pyrite cube is active.
find-paper-active: The last bar: Paper stock has 1 of 4 archived.
find-minerals-with-archived: Archiving deletes nothing: with archived samples included, all 4 mineral specimens are there.
restore-quartz: The task's one operation: restore Quartz point from Mineral specimens, the collection with the most, at the revision the chart showed. The task is done.
find-minerals-after-restore: Quartz point is active again.
approve-undo-restore: The person presses the receipt's Undo, which approves archiving Quartz point again.
undo-restore: Undo the restore with the operation its receipt recorded. The task is to do again.
find-minerals-after-undo: Quartz point is archived again, so Mineral specimens has the most once more.
restore-vellum: A miss: restore Tracing vellum from Paper stock, which had 1 archived sample. It is a real change with a receipt, but the task is not done.
find-paper-after-miss: Every paper stock sample is active.
create-collection: Create one of the person's own collections. The task counts only demo collections, so it never enters the chart.
create-item: Create an item in that collection.
approve-archive-yours: The person confirms archiving their own item.
archive-yours: Archive the person's own item at revision 1.
approve-archive-amber: The person confirms archiving a demo sample that is not in the practice set.
archive-amber: Archive Amber swatch at revision 1.
reset-practice-quartz: Reset Practice, 1 of 5: restore Quartz point, archived again by the undo.
reset-practice-agate: Reset Practice, 2 of 5: restore Banded agate slice.
reset-practice-obsidian: Reset Practice, 3 of 5: restore Obsidian flake.
reset-practice-cobalt: Reset Practice, 4 of 5: restore Cobalt swatch.
reset-practice-ochre: Reset Practice, 5 of 5: restore Ochre swatch. Tracing vellum was already restored, so it is not touched.
find-pigments-after-reset: Reset Practice left Amber swatch archived: it is not a practice sample.
find-minerals-after-reset: Every mineral specimen is active again.
find-yours-after-reset: The person's item is still archived: Reset Practice did not touch it.
find-yours-with-archived: It is there when archived items are included, unchanged.
